---

**Description**
A concise description of what the goal of the feature is.

**Visuals**
Add screenshots or mockups of the expected result (if possible)

**Tasks**
A list of tasks the developer will need to fulfill.
Be precise, the goal here is to answer in advance all the questions the developer could have and guide him into a smooth implementation process.
Some examples:
- [ ] The option state must be saved into the asset
- [ ] Must work with Wintab and Ink
- [ ] Implement the feature in the following tools ...
